name: runtime
description: Runtime operator control plane for agentic-plugins host readiness, doctor diagnostics, settings planning, model/effort config, companion readiness, and workflow ledger health. L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024.

interface.shortDescription: Runtime diagnostics and dry-run settings planning for agentic-plugins
interface.longDescription: L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024. Provides $runtime:doctor as a read-only diagnostic surface for Claude Code and Codex CLI availability, auth state, marketplace/cache/plugin discovery, companion contract compatibility, model/effort resolution observation, companion sandbox/permission readiness, and engineer/orchestrator workflow plus peer-run ledger health. Provides $runtime:settings as a dry-run settings planner with explicit --apply writes limited to agentic-plugins-owned .agentic-plugins/config.toml model/effort defaults. Dynamic consensus, context hygiene, completion footer mutation, deep peer smoke, and automatic plugin install/update apply mode are deferred.
